'''Kaon City''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaon]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. During the [[Rakghoul pandemic|outbreak]] of the [[rakghoul]] virus during the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Kaon City was infected thanks to the unknowing actions of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Melarra]].<ref name="Kaon" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kaon City was created for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and was designed by the art team headed by lead artist [[Andrew Collins]].<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=acollins|url=artwork/l6laG|name=[[Andrew Collins]]|text=SWTOR Interiors}}</ref>
